decks.notes: This Esper Aggro deck focuses on applying early pressure on the opponent by playing efficient and aggressive creatures like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Mockingbird. It also includes disruptive spells like Destroy Evil and Go for the Throat to control the board and clear a path for attacking. The main strategy is to overwhelm the opponent quickly with a mix of evasive threats and removal, while maintaining a steady flow of card advantage with cards like Nurturing Pixie and Stormchaser's Talent. The deck aims to close out the game before the opponent can fully establish their own game plan.

This deck focuses on a fast and aggressive playstyle, utilizing low-cost creatures and burn spells to deal damage quickly to the opponent. The deck aims to flood the board with creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Emberheart Challenger, while also using burn spells such as Burst Lightning and Lightning Strike to clear the way for direct attacks. The inclusion of cards like Screaming Nemesis and Monstrous Rage provides additional damage and threat, making it difficult for the opponent to stabilize their board. Overall, the strategy revolves around overwhelming the opponent with fast-paced aggression.

The deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. It utilizes cards like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Optimistic Scavenger to apply pressure on the opponent while also using spells like Destroy Evil and Go for the Throat to control the board. The mana base supports a combination of different colored spells with a mix of lands that enter untapped to allow for a fast, aggressive start. This deck aims to outpace the opponent and maintain board control to secure a swift victory.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy through counterspells, board wipes, and bouncing their permanents back to their hand. By controlling the board and slowing down the game, you aim to outvalue your opponent with powerful threats like Jace, the Perfected Mind and Overlord of the Mistmoors. The deck also utilizes lands that can provide additional value or utility, such as Blast Zone and Restless Anchorage. By carefully managing resources and outmaneuvering your opponent, you can establish dominance and secure victory through attrition.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on a fast-paced aggressive strategy, utilizing efficient creatures like Cheeky House-Mouse and Emberheart Challenger to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The deck also includes burn spells like Burst Lightning and Lightning Helix to help finish off the opponent or remove threats. Spellbook Vendor and Mabel, Heir to Cragflame provide card advantage and synergy with other creatures. Sheltered by Ghosts and Shardmage's Rescue offer protection for key creatures, allowing them to continue applying pressure. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creatures and burn spells.

The key concept of this Gruul Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and pump spells while protecting your own board with cards like Overprotect and Snakeskin Veil. By utilizing cards like Turn Inside Out and Monstrous Rage, you can take advantage of the Leyline of Resonance to deal massive damage quickly. The deck focuses on tempo and aggression, using efficient creatures like Heartfire Hero and Emberheart Challenger to apply pressure early and often. With a solid mana base and a mix of pump spells and creatures, this deck aims to quickly close out games.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly overwhelm your opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and combat tricks. By efficiently utilizing cards like Might of the Meek and Monstrous Rage, as well as protecting your key creatures with Overprotect and Snakeskin Veil, you can maintain board presence and push through damage. Leyline of Resonance provides additional utility, while the mana base of Karplusan Forest, Thornspire Verge, Copperline Gorge, and Mountain allows for smooth casting of your spells. This deck aims to consistently apply pressure and close out games swiftly.

This deck focuses on aggressive play with a mix of control elements, utilizing cheap spells and creatures to quickly build a board presence. The key strategy involves using card draw and removal spells to maintain momentum while deploying threats early and often to pressure the opponent. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of efficient creatures and burn spells, combining both tempo and card advantage to outpace and outmaneuver opponents. Jeskai Aggro thrives on its ability to apply constant pressure and disrupt opponent's strategies while maintaining a proactive game plan.

Utilize a mixture of removal spells, hand disruption, and powerful creatures to maintain control over the game. Establish board presence with high-value creatures such as Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Harvester of Misery, while keeping your opponent in check with cards like Duress and Go for the Throat. Utilize the land base to ensure consistency and access to the necessary colors for your spells. Stay ahead of your opponent by disrupting their strategy and efficiently dealing with any threats they may pose.

The main concept of this Dimir Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. By using a combination of Faeries and other evasive creatures, as well as removal spells like Go for the Throat and Cut Down, the deck aims to control the battlefield and deal damage efficiently. Enduring Curiosity and Faebloom Trick provide card draw and flexibility, while cards like Spell Stutter and Spell Pierce help to counter the opponent's key spells. The deck's strategy revolves around maintaining pressure while disrupting the opponent's game plan.
